expires_today.title: AI Foundations and Applications by Manning
expires_today.description: The hottest AI summer reading list
expires_today.long_description: Looking for a leg up on apps and AI? We’ve partnered with Manning Publications to curate the perfect summer reading series for curious, tech-focused minds! It all begins with the AI Foundations and Applications Bundle—embark on your learning journey with AI-Powered Search, Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), or Deep Learning with Python, 3e and watch your confidence grow in these red-hot fields of tech. Make summer ’26 the season of growth for your career, and help support Feeding America with your purchase.

expires_today.title: IT & AI: 500+ Certification Exams
expires_today.long_description:
Don’t stress that upcoming test; get the expert-level prep courses you need to dominate the CompTIA exams with our latest bundle from the industry leaders at Mammoth Club! Ace your AWS, NVIDIA, Linux, and CompTIA certifications with this massive library of more than 500 practice exams and supplemental materials. Plus, your purchase includes the Machine Learning & AI Certification Foundations collection. Pay what you want for elite learning and help support the Python Software Foundation with your purchase!
Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 30th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Complete Character Creation for Games
expires_today.description: Bring characters to life in Blender
expires_today.long_description:
Dying to design your own epic game but have no idea where to begin? Been poking around in Blender but haven’t figured out all the tips and tricks? This bundle of Blender software courses will have you creating awesome boss fights and unique characters like you’ve been doing it for years! Learn the basics of character creation with courses on 3D, anime, and even low-poly characters! Bring them to life with comprehensive guides on animation and rigging! Let your imagination run wild sculpting orcs, dragons, mechs, and more! Get hours of resources and advice about all the details of game creation for the low price of your choosing, and support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 23rd, 2027.

expires_today.title: Let's Go Gambling!...aw dang it.
expires_today.long_description:
Spin the wheel, chuck the dice, and win big in our latest bundle focused on tipping the odds in your favor. Combine strategy and chaos as best you can while you navigate through Dicealot’s risky engagements, build multiple winning hands in This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker, or even alter probability itself in Pip My Dice. These tempting tales, plus five more await you, and you’ll be supporting Movember with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 22nd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: The John Scalzi Collection: Old Man's War & More by TOR Books
expires_within_72h.long_description: If you’ve been sleeping on master storyteller and acclaimed humorist John Scalzi, or if you simply have the need to add more of his work to your library, boy do we have the perfect bundle for you! We’ve partnered with TOR to bring you the best that Scalzi has to offer, from epic extraterrestrial war sagas to parodies or your favorite sci-fi series. Join the fight with the geriatric warriors of Old Man’s War, given newer, younger bodies to fight an offworld conflict that soon proves more complex than it seems! Learn the ins and outs of supervillainy with the world’s newest bad guy in Starter Villain! Discover free will with the doomed ensigns aboard a starship in the Star Trek spoof Redshirts! There are so many more worlds, characters, and self-aware jabs at your favorite sci-fi franchises to discover in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choice and support World Central Kitchen with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: VFX Master-Bundle For Unreal
expires_within_72h.description: Discover the very best in VFX
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Crank up the volume on your next game or video with the VFX Master-Bundle for Unreal Engine. This gigantic library of high-quality assets from VRhinoFX gives you the dynamic VFX effects you need to add Hollywood-quality polish to your creative projects. Cast a charm on your players with the powerful RPG - Magic VFX collection, which features Holy Light, Blood, Fire, Poison, Darkness, and Lightning—pay what you want for realistic magical explosions and help support Make-A-Wish, too!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before June 5th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Summer Games Done Quick 2026
expires_within_72h.long_description:
We love to take our time savoring a great game, but we also love the high-octane thrill of speedrunning our way to the end. If you’re also one of those people, and you’re looking forward to speedrunning marathon Summer Games Done Quick 2026, now’s the time to dive into some prep work with some of the games featured at the event! In this bundle you’ll find games like Solar Ash, a stylized action-adventure game full of gravity-defying challenges and thrilling boss battles! Or take on Bomb Rush Cyberfunk, a thrill ride on wheels that’s just as groovy as its title suggests! Or grab a friend and enjoy the Mega Man-inspired action of roguelike co-op 20XX! There’s even more to explore in this bundle celebrating Summer Games Done Quick 2026, so grab it now and grab it fast, and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem Grandma, No! and The Gunk before January 24th, 2027. Redeem all others before July 24th, 2027

expires_within_72h.title: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow and More! by DC Comics
expires_within_72h.description: It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s Supergirl!
expires_within_72h.long_description:
If you’ve found yourself in serious need of comics after seeing DC’s superhero smash Supergirl, or if you want to give yourself a crash course before buying tickets, we’ve got a Supergirl comic bundle just for you! Collected here are the Girl of Steel’s most iconic adventures and essential arcs including all five volumes of Jeph Loeb’s beloved run, all six volumes of Supergirl’s New 52 rebrand, and all four books of Peter David’s delightfully surprising riff on the character. And it looks like a few issues starring a certain alien bounty hunter and a superpowered canine snuck in here too! Whether you’re a new fan or an old friend of the Girl of Tomorrow, grab these comic collections at the price of your choice, and support the real heroes at the Book Industry Charitable Foundation with your purchase!

The titles in this bundle are available through neonichiban.com. To access the content, create or log in to your neonichiban.com account.

expires_within_72h.title: Arc System Works: Evo Collection
expires_within_72h.description: Play Fighting Games. Fight for Something Bigger.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
What’s better than getting a collection of fighting games from Arc System Works in celebration of Evo 2026? Supporting the fight against rare disease while you’re at it. Throw hands in style with big-time fighting games that dominate the competitive scene. Dive into an epic bundle of Guilty Gear titles highlighted by the dynamic 2D x 3D hybrid Guilty Gear -STRIVE-, alongside all five available Season Passes. Or challenge your skills in competitive staples like BlazBlue: Central Fiction and Under Night In-Birth II. Your bundle purchase supports the Raiden Science Foundation and its Fight4Rare initiative, helping ignite hope and advance rare disease treatment and research.

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 17th, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Sonic 35th Anniversary Megabundle by IDW
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Celebrate 35 years of Sonic the Hedgehog with this megabundle of Sonic comics from IDW! What kinds of mischief have Sonic, his pals, and Dr. Eggman gotten into outside of the video games? Now you can find out! Catch the Blue Blur speeding through the pages of the official Sonic the Hedgehog comic series, collected together in 21 volumes of adventure and fun! Stay up to speed on all the Sonic mini-series like Imposter Syndrome, Tangle & Whisper, and Fang the Hunter! Enjoy all your favorite stories plus all the bonus content featured in Sonic’s 30th Anniversary Deluxe Edition! This bundle is perfect for diehard Sonic fans and newcomers alike, so snag it at the price of your choosing before it speeds away, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles should be redeemed before July 11, 2027.
